decision.title: iTunes Festival: London 2012
tracklist: You Need Me, I Don't Need You

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (8 tracks) per https://musicbrainz.org/release/30243e41-56a4-4ec0-b9a3-45536e80aaf6, https://www.lyricfinder.org/album/561426381/iTunes Festival: London 2012 - EP/Ed Sheeran. Live EP of the 2 September 2012 iTunes Festival headline set at the Roundhouse, London (Warner Music; released 2012-09-03). MusicBrainz track order and durations (03:28/04:59/04:40/04:10/05:04/19:46) are independently corroborated by lyricfinder (same 8 entries in the same order, titled with '(Live)' suffix) and by AllMusic (6 tracks, durations summing to exactly 42:07 = tracks 1-6). Tracks 7-8 repeat the recordings of tracks 5 and 2 (same MusicBrainz recordings; 'The A Team' 8th track is 5:01 vs 4:59). The 19:46 'You Need Me, I Don't Need You' is the guest medley finale (Devlin, Sway, Chipmunk, Wretch 32). The full 14-song concert setlist (CapitalFM) is NOT this EP. One source (grokipedia) claims 'Give Me Love' as a 7th track; no other source supports it, so it is excluded.
